summary: The speaker describes what reproach has done to him. His heart is broken, and he looks in vain for someone to comfort him.

senses.definition: The speaker puts this condition between his broken heart and his unanswered search for sympathy. This single use supports the sense of acute distress.

note: The only attestation is וָאָנוּשָׁה. Compare אָנוּשׁ of a wound (Jer 15:18). Whether the two belong to one historical root is uncertain. Lane’s نَاسَ, to swing, provides no matching sense.
